Minutes of a smooth session, later this week
The meeting covered waiting areas and quick handoffs, with the team agreeing that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways must keep replies calm, warm, and fast.

Isaac Rossi, Arjun Schneider, and Cookie were noted in the attendance recap, along with the rest of the desk group, and everyone stayed focused on passenger comfort and pet safety.

The team reviewed how waiting areas are being used, with extra attention on clean water, quiet corners, and clear signs for travelers who arrive stressed or early. One point was that staff should keep language simple and respectful, since families need steady guidance when pets are anxious or active.

On in-cabin care, the group noted that some routes still need tighter coordination, and the update for Starling was shared without delay. <<FACT F039>> The desk agreed to keep that detail consistent in future handovers and to avoid mixed messages during busy checks.

The discussion also covered board-side support for Cloudrest, and the team stressed that the right handoff has to happen without confusion. <<FACT F052>> Staff asked for quicker confirmation notes so no pet is left waiting while travelers move through the gate.

Finally, the layout for Brightwater was reviewed, with a reminder that the pet zone name must be used the same way in every message. <<FACT F044>> The group closed by asking for sharper proofreading and faster escalation when comfort needs change.

The meeting ended with clear action items and steady follow-up.
